verdict.rationale: Docusign's Identify product explicitly offers configurable identity verification methods for sensitive envelopes — SMS one-time-passcode, government ID + biometric checks, and dynamic Risk-Based Verification that adjusts verification strength automatically, plus a '5 identity verifications' fraud-reduction claim — directly matching the legal-ops need to require stronger signer verification on sensitive documents. missing for 10: explicit naming of knowledge-based authentication (KBA) as one of the methods, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
